name: Corner Terrace Cafe - Cornerstone
address: Cornerstone Lifestyle Centre, R404, Blanco, George, 6530, South Africa
description_short: Relaxed all-day cafe at Cornerstone Lifestyle Centre serving hearty breakfasts, quality coffee, and light meals.
description_long:
Tucked into the Cornerstone Lifestyle Centre in Blanco, Corner Terrace Cafe has become a go-to spot for George locals seeking a comfortable, unpretentious place to start the day or meet for a midweek catch-up. The setting is light and breezy, with both indoor and outdoor seating that takes advantage of the Garden Route weather.

The menu leans into all-day breakfast favourites—think generous omelettes, stacks of pancakes, and properly done eggs Benedict—alongside sandwiches, salads, and daily specials. The coffee is consistently good, and the service strikes that balance between attentive and relaxed. It's the kind of place where you can linger over a second cup without feeling rushed.

Whether you're stopping in after a morning gym session, bringing the kids for a weekend breakfast, or need a spot with decent WiFi for a laptop session, Corner Terrace fits the bill without any fuss.
